title: Laredo Groups Team Up to Bring Winter Warmth to Bethany House
excerpt: A warm-clothing drive is collecting coats, blankets and sweaters for women and children at Bethany House, with donations accepted through Nov. 19 at Texas Community Bank and on Saturday at Kia of Laredo.
content:
Local groups are teaming up to bring winter warmth to the women and children at Bethany House, collecting new and gently used coats, blankets, sweaters and other winter clothing, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Bethany House, a Laredo shelter founded in 1981, serves about 80 families a month with meals, showers, legal aid and housing referrals, according to the report.

The drive is a joint effort by the Laredo Fire Department, Texas Community Bank, United ISD, Laredo Heat and Kia of Laredo, according to the report.

Donations are being accepted through Nov. 19 at Texas Community Bank, 203 Lakeview Blvd., and on Saturday from 10 a.m. to noon at Kia of Laredo, 6200 San Bernardo Ave., according to the report.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 16, 2026.
